correctness.rationale: Factor each published summand as (λ/(θ y))^λ n^(−λ)(1+λ/(nθ y))^(−λ); the binomial Taylor remainder, uniformly bounded for n≥1 and y large, is summable by geometric η^n, including differentiated terms. Coefficients are polylog moments Li_{λ+1}, Li_{λ+2}, both positive. Logarithmic differentiation yields hazard correction with the correct sign. Setting y0=(A/q)^(1/λ), q=1−p and solving the survival expansion for y=y0+δ gives δ=−B/λ and remainder O(y0^(−1)). The η↓0 Lomax boundary gives A→(λ/θ)^λ, B→λ²/θ, agreeing with exact quantile.
residual_risks: No uniform finite-y error bound, numerical accuracy guarantee, or new family-wide inference theory.
